canonical_summary: Asparagus is a perennial vegetable usually sown in nurseries from October to March in light but fertile soil and can be used from the first year; planted in well-sealed trenches or beds with varying layouts and spacings. Recommended process after smoking, asparagus is harvested as soon as it emerges from the ground.
